title: Sub2API plugin registry publisher
description: publishers/<id>.json; id must equal the file name and the publisher field of the publisher's plugin manifests.

id.description: At most 27 lower-case letters and digits, with single inner underscores: no hyphen, no double or trailing underscore. Together with a plugin key, the plugin id _<publisher>__<key> must be at most 30 bytes.

github.description: GitHub logins allowed to submit versions of this publisher's plugins (used by the PR check and CODEOWNERS; also copied into index.json, where the console shows them).

items.description: GitHub login: letters, digits and single hyphens, not starting or ending with a hyphen, at most 39 characters.

localized.description: Text per language: zh and en are required, other language keys are allowed.
